name: Klockmort's Creation
summary: Klockmort's Creation marks the successful forging of a specialized suit of armor in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Utilizing an unconventional technique devised by the master armorsmith Furen Longbeard, the gnome blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan shapes raw materials into an extraordinarily resilient piece of gear.

sections.title: A Fusion of Disciplines
sections.body: Forging heavy armor typically belongs to the great anvils of the Great Forge, but Klockmort Spannerspan operates out of Tinker Town. The creation of this armor represents a collaborative triumph between dwarven metallurgical tradition and gnomish mechanical innovation. By adapting Furen Longbeard's rigorous methods, Klockmort finishes an armored breastplate engineered to endure punishment that would crush ordinary steel.

sections.title: Unrivaled Resilience
sections.body: According to Klockmort, the resulting armor boasts structural integrity so great that a siege engine could roll directly over it without causing permanent distortion. The secret lies in the peculiar treatment of rare components, proving that combining ancient dwarven forging techniques with gnomish ingenuity yields armor capable of withstanding the fiercest frontline battles.

faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan is a skilled gnome blacksmith residing in Tinker Town within Ironforge. He assists with intricate mechanical tasks and works in conjunction with dwarven craftsmen like Furen Longbeard to fashion unique, durable gear.

faq.q: Who designed the process to make this armor?
faq.answer: The forging process was devised by Furen Longbeard, an accomplished dwarven armorsmith. Klockmort followed Furen's exact methodology to treat the materials and bring the armor to completion.

faq.q: Why did a gnome blacksmith make this armor?
faq.answer: Klockmort, a gnomish blacksmith, wanted to try Furen Longbeard's new technique on a piece of armor of his own. Because you had helped Furen, he offered you the finished armor in return for gathering the searing coral he needed.

faq.q: What makes this armor special compared to standard plate?
faq.answer: Klockmort claims the completed armor possesses remarkable spring and elasticity alongside rigid durability. He boasts that even if flattened beneath the tracks of a heavy siege engine, the metal would snap right back into its original shape.

faq.q: Where does this armor fit in the path of a warrior's training?
faq.answer: This creation is the culmination of a dedicated series of tasks undertaken by promising Alliance warriors seeking to arm themselves with resilient plate armor custom-forged by Ironforge's finest minds.
Klockmort Spannerspan can be found amidst the workshops, clanking gears, and steam vents of Tinker Town, the gnomish quarter of Ironforge.

angles.text: Commissioning this breastplate is an important milestone for Alliance warriors, providing custom-tempered armor built specifically to endure the crushing blows of frontline combat.
Klockmort's work demonstrates that gnomish ingenuity has a vital role even in heavy armorsmithing, showing how mechanical precision enhances traditional dwarven crafts.
The successful application of Furen Longbeard's formula highlights the value of experimenting with unconventional tempering methods and rare oceanic materials.
